Name: RetroTV-CRT Reshade
Author: johndoe183797
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]RetroTV [/b]is a carefully balanced ReShade preset designed to give [i]Stardew Valley[/i] the nostalgic look and feel of playing on a classic 90s CRT monitor—without sacrificing visual clarity or the game's vibrant charm.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Download & Install ReShade[/b] from the official ReShade website.[/*]
[*]Select [b]Stardew Valley[/b] (
[code]Stardew Valley.exe[/code]) during setup and choose the OpenGL renderer and download standard shader packs.[/*]
[*]Download the [b]RetroTV[/b] preset file (
[code]RetroTV.ini[/code]).[/*]
[*]Place
[code]RetroTV.ini[/code]into your main [i]Stardew Valley[/i] folder (where
[code]Stardew Valley.exe[/code]is located).[/*]
[*]Launch the game, press [b]Home[/b] (or [b]Shift + F2[/b]) to open the ReShade menu, and select [b]RetroTV[/b] from the top dropdown.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][b]Balanced Scanlines:[/b] Subtle, crisp scanlines that enhance pixel art without darkening your screen or straining your eyes.[/*]
[*][b]Warm Phosphor Glow:[/b] Recreates the soft bloom and color warmth of old-school TV screens for a cozy late-night atmosphere.[/*]
[*][b]Authentic Screen Curvature:[/b] Includes optional, light edge curvature and corner vignetting for a true retro display feel.[/*]
[*][b]Preserved Clarity:[/b] Fine-tuned contrast and color accuracy ensure UI elements, text, and item icons remain easy to read during daily gameplay.[/*]
[*][b]Performance Friendly:[/b] Lightweight shaders optimized for smooth performance across all setups.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Reshade

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Enjoying the preset? If [b]RetroTV [/b]made your farm feel a little cozier, please consider leaving a [b]rating[/b] and an [b]endorsement[/b] on Nexus Mods—it helps other players find the mod!
